cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training

The Program Coordinator supports the organized research activities and programming agendas of the France Berkeley Fund (FBF) and the Institute of European Studies (IES) in consultation with the directors of both organizations. This position supports outreach, communications, program development, and fundraising. To further the mission of both programs, the Program Coordinator promotes and supports research by UCB faculty and visiting researchers via the France Berkeley Fund and the IES Global Exchange programs.
Plans and develops new programs and adjusts existing programs in a research and public education environment.

Actively participates with faculty directors (FBF and IES) in long-range strategic planning for research and public educational programs. The FBF, Austrian Studies, Ctr. of French Excellence, Visiting Scholar, and URAP programs.
Monitors and coordinates activities according to the terms of the funding agreements.
Participates in developing constituencies and promoting programs to target audiences.
Identifies and develops evaluation tools for programs.
Under general supervision, assists in implementing specific activities for specific fundraising programs and activities.
Continuing education in related field required.
Additional European Languages a plus.
Working skills to produce and deliver programs.
Working knowledge of departmental and organization policies and procedures and/or the ability to learn; knowledge of educational program content and objectives.
Good reading, verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and good presentation skills.
Working knowledge of delivering public educational programs.
Reading knowledge of basic French.
Working knowledge of current public education programs and trends.
Working knowledge of conducting needs assessment.
Good analytical skills to understand how business needs can be addressed through the design and delivery of training programs.
